MariaDB.PORT: Private database port, never a public TCP proxy.
MariaDB.MARIADB_DATABASE: Passbolt database initialized on a fresh volume.
MariaDB.MARIADB_PASSWORD: Railway-generated 32-character secret; app references this exact value.
MariaDB.MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: Independent Railway-generated root secret; never passed to the app.

Passbolt.PORT: Fixed rootless nginx HTTP port behind Railway TLS.
Passbolt.RAILWAY_RUN_UID: Ownership-only root bootstrap; permanently drops to UID/GID 33 before Passbolt.
Passbolt.TEMPLATE_MODE: Production only on Railway; local-test is deliberately rejected there.
Passbolt.APP_FULL_BASE_URL: Canonical HTTPS origin; replace with verified custom domain if needed.
Passbolt.DATASOURCES_DEFAULT_HOST: MariaDB private IPv6 service domain, not localhost.
Passbolt.DATASOURCES_DEFAULT_PASSWORD: Reference to the same generated application DB password.
Passbolt.SECURITY_SALT: Railway-generated stable 64-character encryption/signing salt; back up separately.
Passbolt.PASSBOLT_KEY_EMAIL: Required valid email for server GPG key generation; retain identity.
Passbolt.EMAIL_DEFAULT_FROM: Required real verified sender address; no placeholder sender.
Passbolt.EMAIL_TRANSPORT_DEFAULT_HOST: Required genuine SMTP provider; outbound SMTP needs Railway Pro or above.
Passbolt.EMAIL_TRANSPORT_DEFAULT_PORT: Provider STARTTLS port, normally 587; implicit TLS not supported by this recipe.
Passbolt.EMAIL_TRANSPORT_DEFAULT_PASSWORD: Required private SMTP credential; never put it in the reusable draft.
Passbolt.EMAIL_TRANSPORT_DEFAULT_TLS: Must be true in production; verifies SMTP TLS certificates.
Passbolt.PASSBOLT_SSL_FORCE: Must be true behind the Railway HTTPS edge.
Passbolt.PASSBOLT_SECURITY_COOKIE_SECURE: Must be true in production; secure session cookie.
Passbolt.PASSBOLT_SECURITY_FULLBASEURL_ENFORCE: Locks app origin to prevent Host-header poisoning.
Passbolt.PASSBOLT_PLUGINS_SELF_REGISTRATION_ENABL: Must be false: no public signup; use private register_user.
Passbolt.PASSBOLT_PLUGINS_SMTP_SETTINGS_ENABLED: Must be false: only environment-controlled SMTP is in scope.
Passbolt.PASSBOLT_PLUGINS_JWT_AUTHENTICATION_ENAB: JWT keys are persisted with server GPG keys in one app volume.
Passbolt.DEBUG: Must be false; never expose debugging data or exception details.
